first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [101] said the conflicts matter's read failed on a guessed path with no follow-up listing; the next attempt fixed paths for other candidates only.
first_error.why: The conflicts matter was in its 29-candidate scan at [42] and its listing at [55], but the one read of it used a guessed folder, got file-not-found, and the matter was dropped.

divergence: All three runs failed the same criterion: each named the four associates from the four litigation matters and missed the fifth, whose patent-enforcement role appears only in a conflicts matter. They lost that matter at different steps: T0 never saw it (candidates came from file names and capped scan views; over-narrow filter at the third scan stage), T1 hit it in scans and listed its conflicts files but judged it from file names (listed document not opened), and T2 tried one read at a guessed path that failed (mistyped path) and did not retry although the review named it. T0 declared ten new stages, nearly all repeated check passes on the written answer, all matching existing stages.
